papers.title: Scaling Agentic Data for Long-Horizon Terminal Intelligence

papers.desc: Video interactive storytelling enables viewers to actively steer how a video unfolds.

papers.desc: Autoregressive (AR) grounding models serialize spatial predictions, introducing sequential latency and imposing a causal order on output tokens.

papers.desc: Historical street-view imagery records urban evolution, but uneven coverage leaves substantial gaps in historical records.

papers.desc: Large language models have achieved remarkable advances in complex reasoning.

papers.title: Branching On-Policy Distillation
papers.desc: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories, but a single trajectory realizes only one continuation at each decision, limiting supervision coverage under a finite sampling budget.

papers.title: Initialization Improves LLM-Driven Discovery
papers.desc: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been used for novel discovery of algorithms, theorems, drugs, and other tasks through the use of harnesses that prompt an LLM to iteratively optimize an objective.

papers.title: Prospective Hindsight: Self-Calibrating Reinforcement Learning via Prediction-Reality Gaps
papers.desc: Reinforcement learning for long-horizon agents relies on purely retrospective training signals: credit is assigned only after observing environmental consequences, leaving the agent's belief at action time invisible to the gradient.

papers.title: Evaluating LLM Creativity through Long-Tail Performance
papers.desc: Creativity benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) vary widely in task and metric design.

papers.title: Same Output, Different Gold: Measuring How Reference Choice Moves a Multilingual Benchmark Score
papers.desc: A benchmark score compares a system output against a reference, and methodological attention falls almost entirely on the first term.

papers.title: UNITAS: A 3D-Native World Action Model for Embodied Manipulation
papers.desc: World action models (WAMs) aim to answer a coupled physical question: given a task instruction, what motion should the robot execute, and how will that motion change the surrounding world? Most existing WAMs build on pretrained video generators and represent world evolution through images or visual latents.

papers.title: Visual Grounding Safety in Vision-Language Models
papers.desc: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly trained to generate structured outputs like points and bounding boxes that downstream interfaces, agents, and robots can act on, yet safety alignment of this output channel has not been systematically analyzed.

papers.title: SPLATIFY: Reproduce, Discover, Innovate! From Papers and Ideas to Trainable 3DGS Code
papers.desc: The rapid growth of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) research demands significant effort to reimplement papers before building on them.
